import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final long MODULO = 1000000007L;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k != 1 && k != 0) {
            int n = (int) p;
            boolean[] residue = new boolean[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                residue[i] = true;
            }

            long answer = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (residue[i]) {
                    long temp = i;
                    for (int j = 1; j < n; j++) {
                        temp = (temp * k) % p;
                        if (temp == i) break;
                        residue[(int) temp] = false;
                    }
                    answer = (answer * p) % MODULO;
                }
            }
            System.out.println(answer);
        } else if (k == 1) {
            long answer = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
                answer = (answer * p) % MODULO;
            }
            System.out.println(answer);
        } else { // k == 0
            long answer = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; i++) {
                answer = (answer * p) % MODULO;
            }
            System.out.println(answer);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
